question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error in the given sentence.

Women and children were often employed in the textile industry during the first __**centuary**__ of industrialisation.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"centuary"** is incorrect and should be replaced with **"century"**. (सदी) • **Example: **Many technological advancements happened during the 20th century. • **"Century"** refers to a period of one hundred years. (सदी) • **Example: **The 21st century has seen significant changes in technology and communication. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: centurie** (सेंचुरी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "century". • **Example:** "Centurie" is not a valid word in English. • **Option 3: centuari** (सेंचुअरी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "century". • **Example: **"Centuari" does not exist in the English language. • **Option 4: centuarie** (सेंचुअरी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "century". • **Example:** "Centuarie" is not a correct English word. 214:T743,
